_help: Theme-song drop-in config for Excavator Blowout. Steps: /workspace/kids_audio/excavator_theme/DROP_IN.md. Baked into index.html at build time (python3 src/build.py). A file that is missing from music/ is simply skipped (silence, no errors). v1.9.1: one approved file (alex_v4/theme_intro_v2) serves as sting AND full song. titleSong=true: the sting keeps playing over the title screen to its hard ending (no fade at the menu); if the intro ran without audio it starts from the top once audio unlocks. fullLoop=false: the song has a hard ending, so it is never looped; no loop file.
source: alex_v4/theme_intro_v2.mp3 (approved by Brett 2026-11-14), re-encoded 160 kbps CBR
